instruction: In the club's training presentation, add strikethrough to the first two Finance Meetings bullet points and apply a Fade transition to slide 5.

command: import pyautogui; import time;  time.sleep(4); pyautogui.click(170, 250); time.sleep(1);pyautogui.press('down'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('down'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('down'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('down'); time.sleep(1);

llm_judge_reasons: Fix was successfully applied: getter now iterates over all slides (prs.slides) when collecting strike_state, ensuring Finance Meetings bullet points on slide 1 are found regardless of their slide location.

Target texts ('Providing another perspective for the clubs and organizations.' and 'Advocating for student Budget Requests.') match the Finance Meetings bullet points confirmed by trajectory evidence; para.text.strip() handles whitespace.
Strikethrough detection via 'all(r.font.strike is True for r in runs)' with empty-run guard is semantically correct for explicitly applied strikethrough through LibreOffice UI.
Transition detection on slide 5 (index 4) is correct: reads p:transition child element's local tag name (e.g. 'fade' from namespaced tag), and metric uses substring match 'fade' in 'fade' = True.
Partial scoring covers all instruction requirements: 0.67/2 per strikethrough item + 0.33 for transition = 1.0 total, with appropriate weights.
The evaluator correctly rejects the initial state (no strikethrough, no transition) and should pass only after both objectives are completed.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Fade transition in LibreOffice-saved pptx might theoretically save with a different child element structure; if test failures occur, consider also checking the 'type' attribute of p:transition directly as a fallback.
